hero.sub: Izinhlobo zama-barcode ezingaphezu kwe-100 endaweni eyodwa. Khetha uhlobo, faka idatha yakho, bese ulanda isithombe.

types.sub: Zonke izinhlobo ezisekelwayo, zihlelwe ngokusetshenziswa. Thepha igama ukuze ulisebenzise kwijeneretha.
how.title: Indlela yokusebenzisa
how.s2d: Thayipha umbhalo, i-URL, imininingwane ye-Wi-Fi, oxhumana naye, nokunye. Vula okuthi Ngobuningi ukuze udale ama-barcode amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
how.s3d: Lungisa usayizi nemibala, bese ulanda i-PNG yekhwalithi ephezulu elungele ukuphrintwa nokwabelana.
faq.title: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
faq.a1: Yebo. Ungadala futhi ulande ama-barcode amaningi ngendlela ofuna ngayo, ngaphandle kokubhalisa futhi ngaphandle kwe-watermark.
faq.a2: Sebenzisa i-QR Code yezixhumanisi, i-Wi-Fi, nabantu oxhumana nabo. Sebenzisa i-EAN-13 noma i-UPC-A yemikhiqizo ethengiswayo, i-Code 128 yokuthumela nesitoko, ne-Data Matrix yamalebula amancane.
faq.a3: Yebo. Izithombe ozidalayo ngezakho ukuzisebenzisa emikhiqizweni, ekupakisheni, nasekuphrintweni. Nge-EAN ne-UPC emikhiqizweni ethengiswayo, bhalisa izinombolo zakho ku-GS1.
faq.a4: Uhlobo ngalunye lunemithetho yalo. Isibonelo, i-EAN-13 yamukela kuphela izinombolo ezingu-12 noma ezingu-13. Funda umlayezo wephutha bese ulungisa idatha yakho.

articles.sub: Amathiphu nemihlahlandlela mayelana namabhakhodi, i-QR Code nendlela yokuwasebenzisa ebhizinisini lakho.
